Reach_link.helptext: Outlet of the Urban_HRU's Reach member (pervious-surface routing) to the receiving channel segment. Same Manning's-equation formulation as Trapezoidal_Channel_link; a distinct type name lets the Reach and the Impervious_Reach be connected as separate exits of the same composite (see Impervious_Reach_link).

Impervious_Reach_link.helptext: Outlet of the Urban_HRU's Impervious_Reach member (impervious-surface routing) to the receiving channel segment. Same Manning's-equation formulation as Trapezoidal_Channel_link; a distinct type name lets the Impervious_Reach and the Reach be connected as separate exits of the same composite (see Reach_link).

Urban_HRU.description: Urban hydrologic response unit with pervious and impervious fractions: an infiltrating (pervious) catchment over a three-layer unsaturated profile, an impervious catchment, two surface-routing reaches, and a groundwater cell underlying the whole unit.
Urban_HRU.helptext: Total HRU area is partitioned by min(impervious_fraction*impervious_multiplier, 0.95). The pervious Catchment and Soil_1..Soil_3 receive area*(1-impervious_fraction); the Impervious_Catchment receives area*impervious_fraction and has no infiltration. The Groundwater cell underlies the WHOLE unit (area), since the aquifer continues beneath impervious surfaces; it is recharged only through the pervious soil column (recharge interface area*(1-impervious_fraction)) by a soil_to_unconfined_groundwater_link: unsaturated conductivity of Soil_3 (K_sat*k_r(Se)) for drainage, saturated conductivity for upward flow. Soil layers are 1:2:4 fractions of depth_to_groundwater, each with its own van Genuchten parameters. The groundwater cell is an Unconfined Groundwater cell (unconfined_groundwater.json): its piezometric head rises by 1/specific_yield per unit of stored water depth, and its initial state is a water-table elevation. Neighbouring units exchange groundwater through UC_groundwater_link. Each surface drains through its own Trapezoidal Channel Segment. impervious_multiplier and K_sat_scale (default 1) are watershed-wide calibration multipliers.

area.description: Total plan area of the Urban HRU
area.helptext: Total HRU plan area. Pervious catchment, soil layers and the recharge interface receive area*(1-impervious_fraction); the impervious catchment area*impervious_fraction; the groundwater cell the whole area.

impervious_fraction.description: Impervious fraction of the HRU plan area
impervious_fraction.warningmessage: impervious_fraction must be greater than 0 and less than 1. Use the Hydrologic Response Unit for land without impervious cover.
impervious_fraction.helptext: Directly connected impervious fraction (DCIA) of the total area, before impervious_multiplier: the share of the land whose runoff reaches a storm drain or the stream without crossing pervious ground (not the total impervious area). The Impervious_Catchment receives area*min(impervious_fraction*impervious_multiplier, 0.95); the pervious Catchment, the soil layers and the recharge interface receive the rest; the Groundwater cell receives the whole area.

surface_elevation.helptext: Ground-surface datum for the HRU. It sets the Catchment elevation, soil-layer elevations, Groundwater bottom elevation, and bottom elevations of the two local routing reaches. For GIS-generated watershed models, GIStoOHQ should assign reach/channel elevations consistently with DEM-derived downstream elevations so Trapezoidal_Channel_link has a physically meaningful hydraulic-head gradient.

depth_to_groundwater.description: Depth from the ground surface to the water table
depth_to_groundwater.warningmessage: The depth to groundwater must be positive!
depth_to_groundwater.helptext: Total thickness of the unsaturated profile. It is split between the three layers in a 1:2:4 ratio, so they are one seventh, two sevenths and four sevenths of this value.

groundwater_thickness.warningmessage: The groundwater thickness must be positive!
groundwater_thickness.helptext: Thickness of the groundwater cell from its base to the bottom of the soil column. Its base elevation is the surface elevation less the depth to groundwater less this thickness; it also sets the recharge flow path.

groundwater_residual_thickness.description: Residual thickness of the groundwater cell
groundwater_residual_thickness.warningmessage: The residual thickness cannot be negative
groundwater_residual_thickness.helptext: Saturated thickness above the cell base that lateral flow to neighbouring units (UC_groundwater_link) cannot remove; for example the depth of the base below the receiving stream bed, so that lateral flow cannot draw the water table below the stream.

recharge_elevation_offset.description: Soil elevation offset in the recharge link
recharge_elevation_offset.helptext: The recharge link evaluates Soil_3 as if it lay this much lower, so that it sits a chosen gap G above the water table: offset = (soil bottom - water table) - G. Only the recharge exchange is affected; the soil, catchments, reaches and groundwater cell keep their elevations. 0 = actual geometry.

Evapotranspiration.description: Evapotranspiration source for the top soil layer (Soil_1)
Evapotranspiration.helptext: Applied to Soil_1. A second, optional source (Evapotranspiration_2) can be attached to Soil_2 and Soil_3 for root-zone uptake below the top layer, and a third (Evapotranspiration_GW) to the groundwater cell.

Evapotranspiration_2.description: Evapotranspiration source for the deeper soil layers (Soil_2 and Soil_3, optional)
Evapotranspiration_2.helptext: Optional root-zone evapotranspiration from Soil_2 and Soil_3. Use a separate source (for example the same reference-ET series with its own corr_fact) so that uptake from the deeper layers can be scaled independently of Soil_1. Each layer's rate is scaled by its own theta/theta_sat. Leave empty for no evapotranspiration below Soil_1.

Evapotranspiration_GW.description: Evapotranspiration source for the groundwater cell (optional)
Evapotranspiration_GW.helptext: Optional evapotranspiration from the groundwater cell (e.g. riparian uptake), normally an Evapotranspiration_Time_Series (Groundwater) source with its own corr_fact. Leave empty for none (the earlier behaviour).

catchment_slope.description: Shared slope of the infiltrating and impervious catchment surfaces
catchment_slope.helptext: Average surface slope applied to both Catchment and Impervious_Catchment. GIStoOHQ may later provide separate surface-specific slopes if available.

catchment_width.description: Shared overland-flow width of the infiltrating and impervious catchment surfaces
catchment_width.helptext: Overland-flow width applied to both Catchment and Impervious_Catchment. GIStoOHQ may later provide separate widths if derived from GIS geometry.

manning_coefficient.description: Manning roughness coefficient of the infiltrating catchment surface
manning_coefficient.warningmessage: The Manning coefficient must be positive!

depression_storage.description: Depression storage depth of the infiltrating catchment surface

runoff_coefficient.helptext: Fixed at 1 for both catchments. GIS imperviousness is represented by area partitioning rather than by runoff coefficient. On Catchment, infiltration is represented explicitly through the surfacewater_to_soil_link and subsequent soil/groundwater processes. On Impervious_Catchment, there is no infiltration link.

K_sat_1.description: Saturated hydraulic conductivity of soil layer 1
K_sat_1.warningmessage: The saturated hydraulic conductivity must be positive!

K_sat_2.description: Saturated hydraulic conductivity of soil layer 2
K_sat_2.warningmessage: The saturated hydraulic conductivity must be positive!

K_sat_3.description: Saturated hydraulic conductivity of soil layer 3
K_sat_3.warningmessage: The saturated hydraulic conductivity must be positive!

alpha_vG_1.warningmessage: van Genuchten alpha must be positive!

alpha_vG_2.warningmessage: van Genuchten alpha must be positive!

alpha_vG_3.warningmessage: van Genuchten alpha must be positive!

n_vG_1.description: van Genuchten n of soil layer 1
n_vG_1.warningmessage: van Genuchten n must be greater than 1!

n_vG_2.description: van Genuchten n of soil layer 2
n_vG_2.warningmessage: van Genuchten n must be greater than 1!

n_vG_3.description: van Genuchten n of soil layer 3
n_vG_3.warningmessage: van Genuchten n must be greater than 1!

theta_sat_1.description: Saturated moisture content of soil layer 1
theta_sat_1.warningmessage: Saturated moisture content must be greater than 0 and no greater than 1.

theta_sat_2.description: Saturated moisture content of soil layer 2
theta_sat_2.warningmessage: Saturated moisture content must be greater than 0 and no greater than 1.

theta_sat_3.description: Saturated moisture content of soil layer 3
theta_sat_3.warningmessage: Saturated moisture content must be greater than 0 and no greater than 1.

theta_res_1.description: Residual moisture content of soil layer 1
theta_res_1.warningmessage: Residual moisture content must be nonnegative and less than saturated moisture content.

theta_res_2.description: Residual moisture content of soil layer 2
theta_res_2.warningmessage: Residual moisture content must be nonnegative and less than saturated moisture content.

theta_res_3.description: Residual moisture content of soil layer 3
theta_res_3.warningmessage: Residual moisture content must be nonnegative and less than saturated moisture content.

soil_specific_storage.description: Specific storage of the soil profile
soil_specific_storage.warningmessage: Soil specific storage must be positive.

initial_moisture_content.description: Initial moisture content of the soil layers
initial_moisture_content.helptext: Initial condition for all three layers. Each layer's initial storage follows from its own area, thickness and this value.
initial_moisture_content.warningmessage: Initial soil moisture content must lie between residual and saturated moisture contents.

groundwater_K.description: Hydraulic conductivity of the groundwater cell
groundwater_K.warningmessage: The hydraulic conductivity must be positive!
groundwater_K.helptext: Hydraulic conductivity of the groundwater cell. Together with unconfined_groundwater_to_stream connector properties and the head difference between Groundwater and the receiving stream/reach, this controls groundwater discharge/baseflow.

groundwater_porosity.description: Drainable porosity (specific yield) of the groundwater cell
groundwater_porosity.warningmessage: Groundwater porosity must be greater than 0 and no greater than 1.

initial_water_table_elevation.description: Initial water-table elevation (same datum as surface_elevation)
initial_water_table_elevation.warningmessage: The initial water table must lie within the groundwater cell (between its bottom and the bottom of the soil column).
initial_water_table_elevation.helptext: Initial water-table elevation of the unconfined groundwater cell (same datum as surface_elevation). The cell's initial storage is groundwater_porosity*(initial_water_table_elevation-z_bottom)*area with z_bottom = surface_elevation-depth_to_groundwater-groundwater_thickness, so the initial water table does not move when groundwater_porosity changes (for example during calibration).

impervious_manning_coefficient.description: Manning roughness coefficient of the impervious catchment surface
impervious_manning_coefficient.warningmessage: The Manning coefficient must be positive!

impervious_depression_storage.description: Depression storage depth of the impervious catchment surface
impervious_depression_storage.warningmessage: Impervious depression storage must be nonnegative.

reach_base_width.description: Base width of the internal routing reach connected to Catchment
reach_base_width.warningmessage: Reach base width must be positive!

reach_side_slope.description: Side slope of the internal routing reach connected to Catchment
reach_side_slope.warningmessage: Reach side slope must be positive!

reach_manning_coefficient.description: Manning roughness coefficient of the internal routing reach connected to Catchment
reach_manning_coefficient.warningmessage: Reach Manning coefficient must be positive!

reach_length.description: Length of the internal routing reach connected to Catchment

initial_reach_depth.description: Initial water depth in the internal routing reach connected to Catchment
initial_reach_depth.warningmessage: Initial reach depth must be non-negative!

impervious_reach_base_width.description: Base width of the internal impervious routing reach
impervious_reach_base_width.warningmessage: Impervious reach base width must be positive!

impervious_reach_side_slope.description: Side slope of the internal impervious routing reach
impervious_reach_side_slope.warningmessage: Impervious reach side slope must be positive!

impervious_reach_manning_coefficient.description: Manning roughness coefficient of the internal impervious routing reach
impervious_reach_manning_coefficient.warningmessage: Impervious reach Manning coefficient must be positive!

impervious_reach_length.description: Length of the internal impervious routing reach
impervious_reach_length.warningmessage: Impervious reach length must be positive!

initial_impervious_reach_depth.description: Initial water depth in the internal impervious routing reach
initial_impervious_reach_depth.warningmessage: Initial impervious reach depth must be nonnegative!

impervious_multiplier.warningmessage: The impervious multiplier must be positive!
impervious_multiplier.helptext: The impervious area is area*min(impervious_fraction*impervious_multiplier, 0.95). Keep 1 unless calibrating the directly connected impervious fraction.

K_sat_scale.description: Multiplier on the saturated conductivity of all soil layers (calibration)
K_sat_scale.warningmessage: The conductivity multiplier must be positive!
K_sat_scale.helptext: Scales K_sat_1..K_sat_3 (and therefore also the recharge conductivity, which is Soil_3's). The top layer is additionally scaled by K_sat_scale_surface. Keep 1 unless calibrating.

K_sat_scale_surface.description: Additional multiplier on the saturated conductivity of the top soil layer (calibration)
K_sat_scale_surface.warningmessage: The surface conductivity multiplier must be positive!
K_sat_scale_surface.helptext: Multiplies the saturated conductivity of Soil_1 only (its K_sat_scale_factor is K_sat_scale*K_sat_scale_surface), so infiltration at the surface - reduced, for example, by compaction of urban lawns - can be adjusted without changing percolation and recharge through the deeper layers. Keep 1 unless calibrating.
